comment: Falls from heights, running drops off an edge (generated drop nav links) and knockback falls (game designer items 6 / 10 / 11a, 2026-11-03; docs/systems/stances-and-movement.md 'Falls and drops'). Read by FallRules::GetConfig (Source/CodexTactics/Public/Falls/FallRules.h) at game start; FFallConfig's defaults mirror these values (test CodexTactics.Falls.Rules.TuningFileMirrorsDefaults). Distances cm, speeds cm/s, times s. Landing (user decision 2026-11-03): below damage.heavy_height_cm (9 m) the ladder-fall curve with one 3 m level free (safe 320 cm, 0.1 HP / cm, max 40); 9-12 m a heavy wound (damage.heavy_min 60 at 9 m .. damage.heavy_max 80 at 12 m capped at damage.heavy_max_health_fraction 0.85 of the body's max health - anyone at full health survives - and the knockdown pose on landing); 12 m and more (damage.lethal_height_cm) kills; operatives and enemies alike. Links for drops of 1.5-6.5 m with a gap of at most 2.5 m. enemy_drops.<archetype>: 0 never, 1 free drops (a hurting one only when there is no other way: + enemy_drops.hurt_entering_cm), 2 jumper (every drop, a pouncing run-up). air.gravity_scale 2.25: gravity x 2.25 in a ledge fall (falls 1.5x faster, user 2026-11-03; the run-up plan / link reach use it, a knockback throw's speeds x 1.5 keep its arc). anim.*: the operative ABP's Falling / Landing states. The pathfinder's extra cost of a drop is in the nav areas (UNavArea_Drop / UNavArea_DropHurt: DefaultCost / FixedAreaEnteringCost, overridable in DefaultEngine.ini). Console: Codex.Fall.DropLinks 0 off / 1 per level JSON "drop_links" / 2 (default) everywhere; a level JSON "drop_link_exclusions" box list suppresses links locally.
